u4-l1#mesto.picture: Emma and Lucia at a viewpoint above Bratislava: the Old Town's red roofs and church spires, the castle on its hill, the Danube curving past.

u4-l1#dedina.picture: A small village in a green valley: a handful of houses with red roofs, a little church, hens in a yard. Emma and Lucia walk up the road with backpacks.

u4-l1#namestie.picture: A sunny square in the Old Town: a fountain in the middle, café tables, old pastel-coloured houses. Emma crosses it with a takeaway coffee.

u4-l1#kostol.picture: On a narrow Old Town street, Emma stops and tips her head back to look up at an old church with a very tall spire.

u4-l1#hrad-je-stary.picture: Bratislava Castle, a big white castle with four corner towers, on its hill above the Old Town. Emma and Tomáš climb the cobbled path up to it.

u4-l1#most.picture: The long modern bridge over the Danube with one tall pylon and a round saucer on top. Tomáš cycles across it.

u4-l1#rieka.picture: Emma and Lucia sit at a café table on the Danube embankment, chatting over coffee; behind them the wide river flows under a long bridge.

u4-l1#vysoky.picture: A slender tower block soars high above the low houses around it. Emma and Lucia, tiny at its foot, crane their necks to see the top.

u4-l2#prepacte-kde-je.picture: On a busy street, Emma, a postcard in her hand, politely stops the woman with the shopping bag to ask the way.

u4-l2#kaviaren.picture: The café near the university: small round tables, a big street window, a counter with a coffee machine. Emma and Lucia sit by the window with coffee and cake.

u4-l2#kino.picture: In a dark cinema, Emma, Lucia and Tomáš sit in a row sharing popcorn, their faces lit by the screen; Lucia gasps.

u4-l2#divadlo.picture: Evening outside a grand old theatre with columns, its windows glowing. Emma and Lucia, dressed up, climb the front steps.

u4-l2#muzeum.picture: In a quiet museum hall full of old folk costumes and painted pottery in glass cases, Emma leans in to look while Tomáš stifles a yawn.

u4-l2#dolava-doprava.picture: At the dormitory door, pán Kováč explains the way, pointing left with one hand and right with the other; Emma, a city map in her hands, tries to follow.

u4-l2#chodte-rovno-potom.picture: The woman with the shopping bag points straight down the street, then sweeps her hand to the right; Emma nods along.

u4-l2#posta-je-oproti.picture: Emma stands on the pavement with her postcard; right across the street is the post office, a yellow postbox by its door. She smiles: found it.

u4-l3#co-robis-som.picture: In the kitchen of Marek's restaurant, Marek in his chef's jacket stirs a big steaming pot and grins at Emma, who peeks in through the kitchen door.

u4-l3#casnik.picture: In Marek's restaurant, Dušan the waiter carries three plates at once between the tables.

u4-l3#predavac.picture: In the clothes shop, a young salesman holds up two boxes to show Emma, smiling and ready to help.

u4-l3#novinar.picture: Outside the university, a young journalist, a man with a notebook and a microphone, interviews pani Horváthová, who looks pleased and a little flustered.

u4-l3#sofer.picture: A bus driver in a uniform cap sits at the wheel of a city bus and waves Emma aboard through the open door.

u4-l3#dochodca.picture: The pensioner feeds pigeons from a park bench, his walking stick resting beside him.

u4-l3#mlady-stary.picture: Two halves. Left: a young man with a backpack skateboards past. Right: the pensioner walks slowly with his stick.

u4-rodina#moja-rodina.picture: In the dorm room, Emma sits on her bed beside Lucia and shows her a family photo from home in Ireland: Emma's mum, Emma's dad, Emma's brother and sister and Emma herself, all smiling in their living room.

u4-rodina#mama-a-otec.picture: At home in Ireland, Emma's mum sits on the living-room sofa next to Emma's dad, his arm round her shoulders, the two of them smiling as if for a photo.

u4-rodina#brat-a-sestra.picture: Marek and his younger sister Lucia goof around in the dorm kitchen: he ruffles her hair and she elbows him, both laughing.

u4-rodina#syn-a-dcera.picture: In the small back garden at home in Ireland, Emma's dad stands with an arm round each of his two younger children, his son and his daughter: Emma's brother and sister. All three grin.

u4-rodina#manzel-a-manzelka.picture: On a Sunday afternoon, pani Horváthová and her husband, pán Horváth, stroll arm in arm across the Old Town square; Emma, passing with a coffee, waves to them.

u4-rodina#zenaty-vydata.picture: Pán Horváth and pani Horváthová sit side by side on a park bench and hold up their hands to show their gold wedding rings, smiling.

u4-l6#grammar-stat-cost-stand.picture: Two halves for the two meanings. Left: at the supermarket checkout, Emma looks at her full trolley and asks how much it all costs. Right: Lucia just stands at a tram stop, waiting.
